[SWS_DM_00967] Support of UDS service ReadDTCInformation, Sub- function 0x0A
⌈
If
a
DiagnosticReadDTCInformation
of
category
’RE-
PORT_SUPPORTED_DTCS’ exists, the Diagnostic Server instance shall sup-
port subfunction 0x0A (reportSupportedDTCs) of the UDS service 0x19 ReadDTCInfor-
mation according to ISO 14229-1[1].
⌋
